verdict.rationale: Eqvista is a cap table, equity management and valuation SaaS platform. The evidence shows no AI agent or assistant inside the product that could act as an MCP client. Plugging MCP servers in so the product can use their tools is a host-agent role outside this product's category, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
